sources.region: Initial audience: English-speaking beginner weekend campers in the northeastern US. Source context: general United States guidance, not park-specific.

sources.sourceTitle: What to Bring — National Park Service
sources.text: Plan for a tent, sleeping pad, and sleeping bag suited to the location and season. A tent’s stated capacity describes sleeping space; account separately for gear or pets. Choose bedding for the conditions and your own needs, and keep dry clothes for bedtime. Check local rules before relying on a hammock or shelter tied to trees.
sources.title: Pack shelter and bedding together
